text: In a decentralized autonomous organization a series of smart contracts grants token holders voting rights, so the blockchain-based smart contract performs the function that articles of incorporation or bylaws perform in a conventional company.
citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2922176

isBasedOn.name: The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies

abstract: A series of smart contracts granted token holders voting rights. In this respect, the blockchain-based smart contract mimics the role of articles of incorporation or bylaws.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: the original DAO structure, running on the Ethereum public blockchain
